title: Exercise 1: Foregrounding Analysis
passage:
pity this busy monster, manunkind,
not. Progress is a comfortable disease;
hint: ابحث عن كلمات مبتكرة (Neologisms) وتركيبات متناقضة (Paradoxes).

tasks.instructions: Identify the elements of foregrounding in this extract and classify their types.

correctAnswers.explanation: Lexical deviation achieved through neologism (nonce-formation) by blending 'mankind' and 'unkind'.
Semantic deviation involving paradox/mismatch between 'comfortable' and 'disease'.

title: Exercise 2: Eliot's Hollow Men
passage:
We are the hollow men
We are the stuffed men
hint: لاحظ التكرار في بنية الجملة (Syntactic Structure).

tasks.instructions: Identify parallelism or repetition in this extract.

correctAnswers.text:
We are the hollow men
We are the stuffed men
correctAnswers.explanation: Structural parallelism where the syntactic structure is identical but the lexical item (hollow/stuffed) varies.
Repetition of the phrase 'We are the' emphasizes the collective, identical nature of the speakers.

title: Exercise 3: Cohesive Devices
passage: The main course was dried lamb chops, dried mashed potatoes, and tinned spaghetti in tomato sauce. Cassandra, leaning across to address someone, entangled her dangling crucifix in the spaghetti. It had to be wiped clean.

tasks.instructions: Extract examples of cohesion, determine their type, and specify references if applicable.

correctAnswers.explanation: Lexical cohesion through the repetition of the word 'spaghetti'.
Pronoun 'It' is an anaphoric reference back to the noun phrase 'crucifix'.
